title: Pulsar Shift Portable Vaporizer (taxes extra)
description:
We only ship the Pulsar Shift to Canada, no USA shipping

The Pulsar Shift Vaporizer is a palm sized but delivers powerful vapor. Works with dry herb, wax and thick oils. At just over 3″ tall, this little vape is truly portable. Featuring a long-lasting, quick charging 1600mAh battery and a large heating chamber. The temperature range is 320-430 degrees, it also includes a safety shutoff feature and easy push-button operation.

Features:
– 2″ x 1″ x 3.2″ (5 x 2.54 x 8.12 cm) dry herb vaporizer
– Quartz insert cup for concentrates
– Quick charging, long lasting 1600mAh battery
– Temperature range from 320 to 430 degrees
– Large heating chamber

Included in the Box:
1 x Shift Vaporizer
1 x Micro-USB to USB Charging Cord
1 x Tweezers
1 x Dabber Tool
1 x Cleaning Brush
1 x User Manual
